verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a software and service identity capability, so the question is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any credential-issuing feature that would make the axis apply.
